spec2def(cryptdll.dll cryptdll.spec)

# cryptdll.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/cryptdll-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
add_cargo_module(cryptdll cryptdll-cargo cryptdll.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
